_meta.purpose: CATALOG_RETRIEVAL (E1) eval corpus — the retrieval-QUALITY gate that catalog-retrieval.test.ts defers ('nothing about retrieval QUALITY, recall, or latency. That is the eval gate's job, on real embeddings'). Indexes this catalog through the REAL path (runCatalogIndex → embed purpose:document → vector store) and runs each shopper query through the REAL retriever (createCatalogRetriever → embed purpose:query → vector top-k), then grades recall@k on real Vertex embeddings.
properties: recall@k (the relevant product is in the retriever's top-k)
no-wrong-product (a focused query does NOT surface a clearly-irrelevant product in top-k)
_meta.grading: expectTop ⇒ the top-ranked id must equal it; relevantInTopK ⇒ at least one of these ids must be in the top-k; notInTopK ⇒ none of these ids may appear in the top-k. k defaults to 3 over this 10-product catalog.
_meta.note: Silent-truncation (postgres-vector-store MAX_SCAN_ROWS, a separate finding) is NOT covered here — that is a store-level property, not a relevance one.
